name: Alexander Bublik
intro: Alexander Bublik plays for Kazakhstan. Friends call him Sasha. He is the trick-shot king of tennis, full of surprises.
story: Sasha started tennis at age two with his dad. He grew up very tall, with a huge serve. In 2025 he beat world No. 1 Jannik Sinner on his way to a title. This year he cracked the top 10 for the first time. In New York he won two matches. Then he played a five-set thriller. Next time, expect a surprise!

funFacts.text: He sometimes serves underhand, just to surprise people.
He loves adding trick shots to his matches, just for fun.
He is 196 cm tall. That is about six and a half feet!
He loves chess. In 2023 he was picked as a reserve for the Levitov Chess Wizards.
He has a little boy named Vasily, born in 2022.
He hit more aces than anyone on tour in 2021. An ace is a serve nobody can touch.
He started tennis at age two with his dad, Stanislav.

watchFor: Watch for a sneaky underhand serve or a surprise trick shot.
